title.en: A place for the things you take along.

body.zh: 把日常小物妥善安放，为出行留一点从容。
body.en: A considered place for your everyday essentials. Ready for your next journey.

body.zh:
告诉我们你感兴趣的款式、采购数量与销售地区。

也欢迎说明包装、样品或其他需求，我们将与你进一步确认商品资料与合作安排。
body.en:
Tell us which styles interest you, the quantity you have in mind, and your sales region.

You can also share packaging, sample, or other requirements so we can discuss product information and next steps.
